answer: Make influence expensive in time, not in signups. The first locked bond an operator posts is treated as a relic bound to one address; it cannot be copied, split, or restaked under a new name for many epochs. Voting weight then opens the way a lotus does, one thin layer after each settled job with an unaffiliated counterparty. Peers check the record against a public mirror of funding trails and timestamps, and any cluster that shares one relic is counted as one voice. A sybil must therefore age a separate relic for every fake, so a weekend of registrations cannot steer the epoch.
